<p>SWE minus the centered-five-day WY2005–WY2025 date-specific median, in inches. Positive values mean more snow water than the reference median.</p>
<p><a href="../maps/generated/snodas/current/swe-departure.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open full-resolution PNG</a></p>

<p>SWE divided by the date-specific median, times 100. Ratios require a median of at least 1 inch and 18 reference years. Gray indicates low typical SWE; this is not a percentile.</p>
<p><a href="../maps/generated/snodas/current/swe-percent-median.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open full-resolution PNG</a></p>
</article>

<p>Net modeled snowpack-water gain or loss over exactly seven days, in inches. This is not snowfall, and losses are not a measure of melt alone.</p>
